# Privacy notice

Public document. Last reviewed in 2023. Terms: [terms](../glossary/terms.md).

## Data we collect
Account details, usage events and support messages.

## Retention
We keep your data for 90 days after you close your account. See [retention policy](data-retention.md) for internal rules.

## Incident notification
We notify affected customers within 7 days of a confirmed breach.
